children: BHP Group said it has appointed Adrian Wood as chief financial officer from mid-February, succeeding Vandita Pant.
Wood, who joined BHP in 2015 and is currently vice president of projects in the company's Minerals Australia business, will assume the role on Feb. 17, BHP said in a statement Thursday.
The miner said Pant, who has been CFO since early 2024, will remain with BHP to provide transition support until March 29.
